title: RCMP investigating death of man in custody
article: \[Paul Alphonse\] was arrested around 4:45 p.m. on April 11 by a patrol officer responding to a complaint of an intoxicated man passed out in front of a store, according to an RCMP news release.
RCMP are investigating the death of a man who fought with a police officer in the city jail after his arrest.
Paul Alphonse, 67, died in hospital seven days later in the interior B.C. town, located 350 kilometres northeast of Vancouver.

Alphonse was arrested around 4:45 p.m. on April 11 by a patrol officer responding to a complaint of an intoxicated man passed out in front of a store, according to an RCMP news release. He and an officer were involved in an altercation in the detachment around 5 p.m. and Alphonse was taken to hospital by ambulance 20 minutes later when he complained of chest pain.
Alphonse was returned to the jail around 6:15 p.m. after being examined at the hospital but returned again four-and-a-half hours later when he continued to complain of chest pain.
Alphonse died at Cariboo Memorial Hospital on April 18.
